summary: Royale Energy filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 attaching a press release dated September 9, 2026, updating operations on its Permian Basin acreage in Ector County, Texas. The company holds a 7.50% working interest in roughly 16,600 gross acres, with nine wells producing and a tenth completing. The ninth well began producing May 2026 at 1,031 bopd and 1,915 mcf/d gross. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is an operational update, not a special situation.
